authority_basis.summary: Record the completed two-normal inertia audit at the rank-one Gram corner.

operations.title: The rank-one Gram corner has trivial commuting inertia
operations.body: For G=diag(1,s,t), the node normal form is W²-st x1²-t x2²-s x3². The s, t, and combined Kummer deck actions each flip exactly two coordinates, act by +1 on the vanishing line, and commute. Support is the existing labelled Gram-minor corner.

operations.title: Two-normal Gram-corner valuation and inertia audit
operations.body: The checker verifies coefficient valuations (1,1),(0,1),(1,0), two flips for each nontrivial deck element, trivial induced monodromies, and zero commutator.

operations.title: Benincasa closes semisimple inertia at the rank-one Gram corner
operations.body: Entry 1176: at G=diag(1,s,t), all three nontrivial Kummer deck elements flip two coordinates, so Ts=Tt=Tst=1 and [Ts,Tt]=0 on the node cycle. The support is the existing two-normal Gram-minor corner. The remaining finite question is the derived doubled special fiber W²=0—Cartier/Koszul extension or Tor—not further monodromy.
